title: Surreal Clock
description: A large round clock face hangs on a plain wall. The clock shows a green hill scene in the center with a path and tower, and its face holds many small objects like butterflies, a bat, balls, tools, and a small watch.
prompt: A large round clock with roman numerals hangs on a plain wall. The center of the clock face shows rolling green hills with a stone path leading to a tall tower building. Many small objects are placed around the clock face including orange and black butterflies, a black bat, a small white watch, colored balls, tools, and other items. The clock has a brown outer rim. Painted in a detailed realistic style.
